name: Oshiri Princess ~Koujoku ni Chiru Setsuki Reiki~
original_name: お尻ぷりんセス～肛辱に散る拙き隷姫～
source:
Poor girl becomes bride candidate for the prince. However, she can't enjoy samurai wife life just yet. Prince makes her undergo a harsh bride training involving tentacles every day.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
贫困女孩成为王子的候选新娘。然而，她还无法享受武士妻子的生活。王子让她每天接受包含触手的严苛新娘训练。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
